messages:
maria_sales: Morning — AtlasCare finalizing POC scope. They want to test med-qa-7b-v2 on Private (VPC) with CMEK + HSM and int4 quant. Can infra confirm int4 KV-cache behavior and whether tokenizer (SentencePiece 32k) is a known-good path?
ash_se: We have baseline support for med-qa-7b family. SentencePiece 32k is commonly used, but we need to verify tokenization mapping exactly matches their training export. Small mismatch -> huge perf/regression risk.
raj_infra: I can run a compatibility matrix. Main checks: tokenizer parity, int4 generation stability (KV cache), and perf for 128/512 seqs under 1-2 concurrent sessions.
maria_sales: Client requires interactive latency: p50 <= 150ms at 1-2 concurrent users. Also asked for a POC cost estimate for 4 weeks.
raj_infra: Quick note: int4 reduces memory and increases throughput on Ampere/Blackwell GPUs, but some kernels may fall back to fp16 for attention; need to validate end-to-end. If stable, cost per token should be lower vs fp16. I will test both int4 and fp16 canaries.
katie_security: For SOC2/KMS Qs: we support CMEK with customer KMS integrations. HSM-backed key stores via partner KMS are supported in Private deployments. Key rotation: customer-controlled, Redwood does not retain plaintext keys. Audit logs: can be exported to their SIEM; retention configurable. Will draft a short answer.
maria_sales: Please add that draft here when ready. Also, any legal blocker re: sharing SOC2 artifacts?
katie_security: We can share SOC2 audit summary and controls under NDA. Mention: "We maintain SOC2 Type II artifacts and can provide them to authorized contacts under NDA; audit logs and key access records are available for review."
infra_bot: New ticket created: RINF-8842 — "AtlasCare med-qa-7b-v2 compatibility sweep". Tasks: tokenizer parity, int4 vs fp16 regression, perf harness. ETA 72h. Assignee: raj_infra.
raj_infra: Starting tests now. Test config I'm running: ```model: med-qa-7b-v2
variants: [int4, fp16_canary]
seq_lengths: [128,512]
concurrency: [1,2]
tokenizer: sentencepiece-32k
metrics: [p50_latency, p95_latency, perplexity_diff]```
ash_se: Add a fuzz set from their sample prompts and flagged medical terms. If tokenizer drift appears, we can propose a token-embedding remap or request a canonical tokenizer export from AtlasCare.
maria_sales: I'll ask them to provide tokenizer artifacts and a small prompt corpus. Also drafting POC pricing: we usually quote Dedicated quant tier + Private infra surcharge + support hours. Will share draft after Raj posts numbers. :thumbsup:
